tt_plaid_turn_down_email_body
textTemplates.text:
Thanks for taking the time to apply with National Funding. Unfortunately, you don’t meet our minimum qualification for annual gross sales. However, you may be eligible for financing solutions at one of our partners.

View Alternative Financing Solutions


We know business needs change and companies expand, so if your company grows and needs access to additional capital, please reach out to us again. It’s our privilege to help growing businesses like yours.

National Funding respects your privacy. Our commitment to your privacy is described in our privacy policy, which is available on our website for your reference.

{!formula_this_year} National Funding. All rights reserved.
